selection_reason: 浅色留白、大瓶身与单侧牡丹构成轻盈的高级花香视觉。

analysis.caveat: 花朵不能遮挡商品标签。

selection_reason: Professionally resolved celebrity-led fragrance advertisement with clear campaign typography and product integration.

analysis.composition: Close-up portrait dominating the left and center, balanced by the product shot and logotype in the lower right quadrant.
analysis.negative_space: Minimal, mostly occupied by the model's face and a softly blurred background.
analysis.lighting: Soft, diffused studio lighting highlighting facial features with cool undertones.
analysis.typography: Clean, white sans-serif logotype and tagline placed in the lower right, distinct from the product label.
analysis.information_density: Low, focused on the model's gaze, brand name, and product.

selection_reason: Highly resolved luxury perfume still-life featuring classical sculptural props and symmetrical composition; excellent design reference for opulent, heritage-driven fragrance campaigns.

analysis.composition: Symmetrical arrangement with the perfume bottle elevated on a central column, flanked by classical busts and broken pillar fragments on a seamless white background.
analysis.negative_space: Generous clean white space at the top and bottom, focusing attention entirely on the central tableau.
analysis.lighting: Soft, diffused studio lighting creating gentle gradients on the white plaster and distinct, soft shadows anchoring the columns to the floor.
analysis.typography: None outside the container; text is limited to the product label printed directly on the glass bottle.
analysis.information_density: Low; purely visual and atmospheric with no external campaign copy.

selection_reason: Professionally resolved perfume still-life with strong summer thematic styling, vibrant color palette, and clear product focus. Useful as a design reference for seasonal fragrance campaigns.

analysis.composition: Centralized product placement on a geometric white pedestal, flanked by thematic props (fruit slice, flower, amber stone) against a bright sky background.
analysis.negative_space: Ample negative space in the upper sky area, providing room for potential campaign copy.
analysis.lighting: Bright, high-key naturalistic lighting simulating intense sunlight, creating a warm, summery atmosphere with soft shadows.
analysis.typography: None visible outside the container. Text on the bottle is product labeling.
analysis.information_density: Low, focused entirely on the product and mood.

selection_reason: Professionally resolved perfume still-life featuring a sculptural arrangement of Fendi bottles on concrete blocks. High design value for reference.

analysis.composition: Vertical, architectural stack of geometric concrete blocks interspersed with glass perfume bottles in various orientations.
analysis.negative_space: Expansive, clean off-white background surrounding the central vertical structure.
analysis.lighting: Bright, directional studio lighting creating distinct, sharp shadows to the right, emphasizing volume and texture.
analysis.typography: None visible outside of product labels.
analysis.information_density: Low; focused entirely on the product arrangement and material contrast.

selection_reason: Professionally resolved perfume still-life featuring a creative stacked composition of two distinct fragrances. High-quality studio lighting highlights glass textures and liquid colors against a clean background, making it a strong reference for product arrangement and material rendering.

analysis.composition: Vertical stacking arrangement where a cylindrical bottle balances horizontally atop a rectangular bottle, creating a sculptural, gravity-defying focal point.
analysis.negative_space: Generous, clean off-white space surrounding the central stack, emphasizing the product forms.
analysis.lighting: Soft, high-key studio lighting with precise specular highlights on the glass curves and metallic atomizer, casting soft shadows to the right.
analysis.typography: None visible outside the container; text is limited to embossed metal plates and printed labels on the bottles themselves.

selection_reason: 黑色丝绸与瓶身形成材质对比，金色标签提供唯一暖色焦点，适合第一版暗色高级风格。

analysis.caveat: 商品主体与背景反光须控制对比，避免背景高光抢焦点。

selection_reason: Highly resolved luxury perfume still-life featuring a Cartier flacon integrated with illuminated vintage Edison bulbs. Excellent dramatic lighting, reflective surface work, and conceptual prop styling make it a strong design reference.

analysis.composition: Radial arrangement of glowing filament bulbs surrounding a central, diagonally placed perfume bottle on a dark reflective surface.
analysis.negative_space: Dark, moody periphery with subtle teal gradients and reflections anchoring the glowing subjects.
analysis.lighting: Dramatic practical illumination from the bulb filaments creating warm internal glows, contrasted against a cool, dark ambient background with sharp specular highlights on glass and metal.
analysis.typography: None. The script on the bottle is container labeling, not external campaign typography.
analysis.information_density: Low, focused entirely on the product and conceptual props.
